title: Imposter
description: Centers an element over its positioned container, like a dialog or badge laid over content. It applies to any element, so it names no host.

breakout.description: Position against the viewport instead of the container (position: fixed), so the element stays put when the page scrolls. Bare attribute.

margin.description: Keep the element at least this far inside its container's edges (any CSS length). The default 0 lets it fill them.
